purpose: The regulatory receipt. Aggregates N execution_hashes from an agent session into one SHA-256 Merkle-root session receipt with per-leaf inclusion proofs and an ordered chain-depth map. Sets session_receipt_root. The tamper-evident audit object for EU AI Act Art. 12 record-keeping + DORA. Consumes ANY ChainGraph artifact; feeds CRY-04, PTG-01.
